assertions.requirement: Username-only hosted startup must exit nonzero within 10 seconds with both owner arguments required.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/local-api-process.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.accessPolicy rejected startup via LocalApiProcess.create with the owner username only; rejectedCommand within 10 seconds.

assertions.requirement: The shipped hosted server seeds owner username and immutable GitHub ID before protected requests succeed.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.accessPolicy #hosted owner anycloud-test id 1; #policy reads owner_username and owner_user_id.

assertions.requirement: Copy real persisted API state after graceful shutdown, restart under a renamed owner with the same ID, and require authentication to refresh display metadata without changing identity.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/local-api-process.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.accessPolicy restoreFrom the stopped original, start as renamed-owner with id 1, #policy owner_user_id unchanged and username refreshed.

assertions.requirement: Bind a pre-durable owner policy without rewriting legacy Workload owner IDs; hosted members can read both current and earlier captured usernames.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.accessPolicy #seed legacy rows; rewritten count 0 via databaseInteger; #workloadIds includes legacy-current-handle and legacy-previous-handle.

assertions.requirement: A caller matching the owner username but using a different GitHub account ID is denied.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.accessPolicy other-owner fixture; #denied asserts rejectedCommand with API access denied.

assertions.requirement: An allowlisted immutable ID survives restart, then loses protected-route access immediately after CLI removal.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.accessPolicy #allowed after restart keeps user_id 1; the owner's removal then #denied without an API restart.

assertions.requirement: CLI add and list identify the owner and resolve a member to a nonempty immutable account ID.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.accessPolicy api access add/list; list.owner.userId 1, member-user with a numeric userId.

assertions.requirement: A remaining member can read and terminate a departed member's Workload after revocation.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.accessPolicy departed fixture; #workloadIds includes member-workload and #terminate succeeds.

assertions.requirement: A local API lists its caller's Workload and hides other immutable owners and legacy rows captured under another username.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.accessPolicy local fixture; localIds include own-workload and exclude other-user-workload and legacy-other-handle.

assertions.requirement: A second test-mode GitHub token signs in as a real caller, lists access and terminates the owner's Workload but is refused granting or removing access; a never-added stranger is denied.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.accessPolicy peers fixture; teammate lists access, is refused api access add third-user and remove teammate, #terminate owner-workload; #denied for test-token:stranger.

assertions.requirement: The owner issues a service token through the shipped CLI; the API stores no plaintext, the token authenticates through ANYCLOUD_API_TOKEN as kind service, cannot issue another, is refused on its next request after rotation, survives a restore of the backup that holds it, and is refused after removal.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.accessPolicy #serviceTokens api access add --service ci --json, service-token-at-rest, rotated-service 401 and current-service 200; restored-service-token 200 then removed-service-token 401.
